name: Foxconn Semiconductor Facility
summary: Fast-track cleanroom MEPF for an Apple semiconductor manufacturing facility — two ISO-class floors of 14,000 sqm delivered in three months.
narrative: Foxconn assigned Unique Engineers to deliver fast-track packages for a semiconductor manufacturing facility under tight deadlines. The project required multi-service MEPF execution in active clean rooms, emphasising precision, contamination control, and strict sequencing. Installations had to meet ISO clean-room standards while ensuring continuous site progress.

Despite aggressive schedules, Unique Engineers delivered two floors of 14,000 sq m each within three months by deploying a workforce of 1,500+. The project was completed ahead of schedule and recognised with a performance bonus of ₹12 Cr for early delivery.

Clean-room execution required high-precision installation of process utility piping including CDA (Compressed Dry Air) system, Nitrogen and Vacuum networks. Systems were routed with strict slope control, leak-tested to stringent standards, and integrated without compromising contamination zones.
hero_image_alt: Foxconn semiconductor cleanroom interior with process piping and lighting array

execution_snapshots.title: Clean Room Excellence
body: The HVAC system included HEPA-filtered air-handling units, laminar airflow ducting and pressure cascade control to maintain ISO-class conditions. Electrical containment, drainage and specialty supports were installed with micron-level alignment to prevent vibration, particulate shedding and airflow disruption within the semiconductor environment.

Clean-room execution required high-precision installation of process utility piping including the CDA (Compressed Dry Air) system, Nitrogen and Vacuum networks. Systems were routed with strict slope control, leak-tested to stringent standards, and integrated without compromising contamination zones.

name: Ingka Centre
summary: UEL's largest single-order project — full MEPF, solar and PNG for IKEA's flagship Indian mixed-use development.
narrative: The firm's biggest single-order mandate to date — full MEPF and solar services, with PNG. Unique Engineers Limited is handling all the MEPF and solar services along with PNG. A further ₹450 Cr second phase for office and hotel floors is in the pipeline.

The project is delivered against a fully coordinated multi-disciplinary BIM model at LOD 400 across HVAC, Firefighting, Plumbing, Electrical, Solar and PNG systems. All services are integrated into a federated 3D environment where real-time clash detection and inter-trade coordination are completed before site installation.

Shop drawings are generated directly from the coordinated model to ensure execution accuracy and minimise rework. The modelling process is creating a digital twin of the project, enabling constructability validation, accurate material take-offs, prefabrication planning and lifecycle-ready asset data.

name: Common Central Secretariat — Executive Enclave
summary: IGBC-Gold administrative complex with 16,000 TR HVAC plant, 5,00,000 sqm ducting and 1,00,000 m piping — optimised for lifecycle carbon reduction.
narrative: The Common Central Secretariat — Executive Enclave in New Delhi is a landmark administrative infrastructure development. Unique Engineers completed large-scale HVAC and Firefighting works across this high-security, high-performance office complex within a 3-year schedule.
Delivered as a high-performance government office complex with IGBC Gold certification, with sustainability embedded into the mechanical and fire systems from design through execution.

A 16,000 TR high-efficiency HVAC plant was installed with optimised air distribution across 5,00,000 sqm of ducting and 1,00,000 metres of piping. The system uses energy-efficient chillers, optimised airflow balancing, reduced pumping losses and intelligent zoning to improve lifecycle performance while supporting long-term carbon reduction targets.

name: Nalanda University
summary: India's first net-zero university campus — thermal storage, brine chillers and geothermal VRV tied into an IBMS for real-time energy control.
narrative: Nalanda University, Rajgir, was developed as India's first net-zero university campus. Unique Engineers delivered advanced HVAC systems and Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS), aligning mechanical performance with long-term sustainability objectives.

The campus incorporated energy-efficient HVAC technologies including thermal energy storage for peak-load optimisation, brine chillers for enhanced heat transfer efficiency, geothermal water-cooled VRV systems, and advanced evaporative cooling strategies.

An Integrated Building Management System (IBMS) was implemented to monitor and control HVAC operations, energy consumption, and system performance in real time. This ensured centralised visibility, optimised load management, and sustained energy efficiency across academic and residential blocks. The combined mechanical and digital infrastructure supports long-term carbon reduction while maintaining occupant comfort and operational reliability.

name: SAEL Solar Cell Manufacturing
summary: India's first 5.75 GW domestic solar-cell facility — full HVAC, cleanroom and process-cooling MEPF across 66,000+ sqm of ISO 6/7/8 zones.
narrative: India's first 5.75 GW domestic solar-cell facility — full HVAC, cleanroom and process-cooling MEPF in a single engagement. ISO 6/7/8 cleanroom zones across 66,000+ sqm with GSS ducting, insulation, pressure cascade between zones and DOAS make-up.

Hydronics and controls scope includes 29,250 TR of installed cooling, primary-secondary distribution, dual 5.05 MW SS316 plate heat exchangers for process cooling water, and a unified BMS + SCADA + historian. 1,400+ sensors and instruments across the facility tie into the controls plane.

Air-side delivery includes 13,656 fan filter units, 217 air-handling units and 130 make-up air units. The project is being executed against the SAEL PMO's tier-1 commissioning protocol with weekly earned-value reporting and a 3-week rolling look-ahead.
hero_image_alt: Solar cell manufacturing cleanroom interior at SAEL

name: Tabreed Amravati District Cooling
summary: Single-window design-build engagement — full district-cooling design plus civil + MEPF execution across 30,000 TR central plant and multi-km CHW network.
narrative: Design–build engagement in final stages of commercial close — UEL leading both engineering and construction. Full district-cooling design includes a central chiller plant, primary-secondary distribution network, ETS specifications, and BMS/SCADA architecture, LEED-aligned.

Construction scope covers civil and MEPF execution, chilled-water distribution across multiple kilometres, energy transfer stations at consumer buildings, TAB and operational commissioning. Long-term O&M under discussion.
30,000 TR of central-plant capacity, multi-kilometre CHW distribution, 5+ ETS at consumer buildings — all delivered under a single accountable design-build contract.

name: Tata Electronics Dholera
summary: Three design-build packages awarded for India's first commercial semiconductor fab — pipeline expected to expand toward ₹500 Cr as further packages are awarded.
narrative: First-of-its-kind commercial semiconductor fab in India. Three packages awarded; expansion into the fab utility build expected in the next phase.
Design-build scope covers underground piping, electrical infrastructure, and civil excavation — engineered and executed under one contract, supporting the upcoming fab build.
Currently executing at approximately ₹50 Cr, with scope expected to expand toward ₹500 Cr as further packages are awarded.

name: JSW EV Manufacturing
summary: Complete MEPF for a JSW electric-vehicle manufacturing facility including ISO 7/8 battery-assembly cleanroom zones.
narrative: Industrial MEPF services delivered for an electric-vehicle manufacturing facility — automotive electric-vehicle manufacturing for the JSW Group.

Scope includes full MEPF and ISO 7/8 battery-assembly cleanroom zones within the broader manufacturing facility. PCW distribution to battery-line equipment with plate heat exchanger interface to primary cooling. Compressed-air distribution for battery-line pneumatics and tooling.

name: STT GDC Mumbai (NMDC01)
summary: Precision HVAC for the ground and first-floor data halls of a live STT GDC campus — 9 MW capacity, NABL-calibrated witnessing.
narrative: HVAC scope includes chilled-water piping with complete valve assemblies, precision air-conditioning for data-hall environments, AHU installation & commissioning, ductwork, insulation, and air distribution.
Testing and commissioning included full T&C and performance verification per the operator's commissioning protocol, NABL-calibrated instrumentation and witnessed records.
Coordination model: direct interface with the STT project team, weekly site reviews, single-window accountability across the HVAC scope.

name: CtrlS Mahape Mumbai
summary: End-to-end MEP delivery for a live 20 MW colocation facility — HVAC, electrical, fire, plumbing across four floors.
narrative: GC MEP fit-out for Floors 6-9 of a live CtrlS colocation facility — 20 MW total capacity.

HVAC: TFAs, AHUs (CW & DX), HACs, dehumidifiers, VRF/VRV, CW piping (25-350 mm), ventilation, BMS DDC integration. Electrical & ELV: 22 kV HT (bus duct to CSS), LT to rack sockets, cable trays, earthing, FAS / VESDA / WLD / LLD / PA, BMS (DDC + H₂ sensing), access control, CCTV.
Fire fighting & plumbing: Pre-action (UL/FM), 823 sprinklers per floor pair (K80/K115), MS piping 25-150 NB, NFPA-13 compliant, domestic water, UPVC/CPVC piping. Full GC MEP scope across four floors.

name: Digital Edge BOM01
summary: Mechanical, HSD fuel and seismic systems across a 48 MW data centre — 900+ Mason spring isolators, NV5-compliant seismic design.
narrative: Mechanical scope: desiccant dehumidifiers (~2,700 CFM, 42 kW), fans, CW piping (Ø80mm-Ø450mm), 33+ VRF indoor units, 26 stratified tanks, 24 CW pumps, GI ductwork, 110+ motorised damper actuators.
Seismic supports: 900+ Mason spring isolators, seismic snubbers, flexible connectors, cable/pipe bracing — NV5-compliant seismic design across MEP services.
